summary: Verified (A) Emergent Google Sign-In on patient variant only, (B) shared internal Attachments panel across imaging/bloodwork/messages with upload PNG+PDF, disallowed .txt rejection, view button, and remove; plus backend isolation for patient (403) and admin happy-path CRUD on /api/internal/imaging/{id}/attachments. Existing regression logins (admin, physician PAGUAYO, patient maria.lopez) all succeed and route to correct dashboards.
critical_code_review_comments: SignIn.jsx: Google button correctly gated with !internal && !partner (count verified 1/0/0 across /signin, ?internal=1, ?partner=1). session_id one-shot handling uses a useRef guard which is correct.
Attachments.jsx: 15MB client-side guard + accept attribute set to .pdf/.jpg/.jpeg/.png; input value reset after pick so re-selecting same file re-triggers upload. Good.
Queue.jsx renders <Attachments/> only when attachmentEntity prop is set — verified passed only from ImagingQueue/BloodworkQueue/MessageQueue (not RxQueue). Correct scope.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Google visibility + patient/physician login + attachments upload/list/view/remove/reject on 3 entities)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded 2 attachments (1 PNG + 1 PDF) per entity on the first row of imaging/bloodwork/messages queues during E2E; the first attachment on each was removed at end of test but the second PDF remained. Consider cleanup if needed for demo hygiene.
